title: Candidate Interview Checklist Form
subtitle: Use this checklist to verify readiness and execution, expose failed checkpoints, authorize the next state, and preserve accountable handoff for a candidate interview workflow.
description: An original operational candidate interview checklist form that controls a interview stage and candidate record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the recruiting coordinator or interview lead needs a traceable checklist so the qualified recruiting or HR reviewer can advance, hold, decline, reschedule, or obtain additional job-related evidence under the approved requisition, structured interview plan, privacy rules, and applicable equal-employment requirements without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Candidate Interview checklist assignment and operating boundary
sections.guidance: Identify the event, accountable operator, reviewer, applicable references, and required completion point.

blocks.label: Event scope, operating objective, affected population, exclusions, and required outcome

sections.title: Candidate Interview readiness and source-record verification
sections.guidance: Confirm the task is ready and the operator has the correct information before checking execution.

blocks.label: Candidate Interview readiness checks
items: Active requisition and current position description are confirmed
Interviewers have assigned competencies and no duplicate coverage gap
Question set and rating anchors match the interview stage
Candidate identity is confirmed without collecting unnecessary identifiers
Format, access instructions, time zone, and contact route are accurate
Accessibility requests are routed to the designated confidential process
Panel conflicts or prior relationships are disclosed and resolved
Interview notes are limited to job-related evidence

blocks.label: Source records and evidence available
items: Approved requisition and current position description
Structured question set and scoring anchors
Panel assignment and competency coverage plan
Candidate schedule and delivery confirmation
Individual interview notes and completed scorecard
Work-sample instructions, submission, and evaluator record
Conflict, adjustment, or incident routing reference
Candidate next-step communication and recruiting-system entry

sections.title: Candidate Interview execution checkpoints and traceable results
sections.guidance: Record each checkpoint against observable evidence and identify every condition that is not complete.

blocks.label: Candidate Interview execution checkpoints
items: Active requisition and current position description are confirmed
Interviewers have assigned competencies and no duplicate coverage gap
Question set and rating anchors match the interview stage
Candidate identity is confirmed without collecting unnecessary identifiers
Format, access instructions, time zone, and contact route are accurate
Accessibility requests are routed to the designated confidential process
Panel conflicts or prior relationships are disclosed and resolved
Interview notes are limited to job-related evidence
Each rating includes evidence and an anchor-based rationale
Panel members submit independent ratings before group calibration
Candidate communication contains the correct next step and owner
Records are stored in the approved recruiting system with limited access

blocks.label: Checkpoint, observed evidence, result, operator, and follow-up
Observed conditions, sequence, evidence references, deferred checks, and operating limitations

sections.title: Candidate Interview failed checkpoint and escalation control
sections.guidance: Do not hide an incomplete or failed checkpoint inside free text; route it with an owner and due point.

blocks.label: Checklist stop and escalation boundary
blocks.guidance: Pause any action outside documented authority. Protect privacy, preserve the original evidence, and route urgent, safety, security, retaliation, or legal concerns to the qualified recruiting or HR reviewer under the approved requisition, structured interview plan, privacy rules, and applicable equal-employment requirements.

blocks.label: Candidate Interview exception and escalation triggers
items: Inappropriate or non-job-related question was asked
Candidate information reached an unintended recipient
Interview recording occurred without required authorization
Technology failure materially reduced the candidate's opportunity
Panel conflict of interest or prior relationship was disclosed
Approved interview questions or scoring anchors were not used
Candidate reported harassment, bias, retaliation, or unsafe conduct
Work sample, notes, or scorecard was lost, altered, or misattributed

blocks.label: Exception, immediate action, owner, due point, and disposition register
Exception facts, affected scope, privacy boundary, unresolved risk, and escalation rationale

sections.title: Candidate Interview verification and proceed decision
sections.guidance: Use an independent review where required and state the exact boundary of any proceed decision.

blocks.label: Checklist and qualified-review boundary
blocks.guidance: A completed checkbox is evidence only when the underlying condition was observed. The qualified recruiting or HR reviewer must apply the approved requisition, structured interview plan, privacy rules, and applicable equal-employment requirements before any restricted, safety, security, legal, medical, payroll, or tax decision.

sections.title: Candidate Interview checklist handoff and closeout
sections.guidance: Preserve the final state, unfinished work, receiving owner, and reopen trigger.

blocks.label: Open candidate interview action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance
